topic: 5 minute jungle explorer workout for kids
characterReference: selected KM-006 Szene 01 cover reference ONLY
introVoiceText: Welcome, jungle explorers! Today we’re taking on twelve fun freeze challenges in a five-minute jungle adventure. Follow along and hold each pose strong. Clear some space, move at your own pace, and stop if anything hurts. Trail ready? Let’s begin!
